levelIntro: Your daily level is your calorie amount for today. Training lifts it; on rest days it eases.

night.withName: Still up, {{name}}? The day is nearly done.
night.noName: Still up? The day is nearly done.

trainingDayMorning: Training day. The swell arrives once you’ve moved.

bridgeToFood.0: Session saved. Now is a good moment for protein.
bridgeToFood.1: Training done, the plate is next. 30 to 40 g of protein fits well now.
bridgeToFood.2: After training: put something with protein on the plate.

trainingGrewLimit.1: Training lifts your level by {{kcal}} kcal.
trainingGrewLimit.2: {{kcal}} kcal more room, thanks to training.

trainingDay.1: Training is on today. Level so far: {{kcal}} kcal.
trainingDay.2: Training day, and your level rises with every session. Right now {{kcal}} kcal.

restDay.0: Rest day. Recovery is part of the plan.
restDay.1: A break from training today. Your body is still working.
restDay.2: Rest day. Recovery counts as training too.

balanced.0: Round. That was a balanced day.
balanced.1: Your day sits right in range.

night.0: The day is done. Sleep well.
night.1: That is enough for today. Tomorrow carries on.
night.2: Quiet night. The next day starts from zero.

taktReached.1: Two rings are closed. Your rhythm is set for this week.

monday.0: New week, new rings. There is nothing to catch up on.
monday.1: Monday. The week starts at zero, with no baggage.
monday.2: New week. Everything that came before still counts.

friday.0: Friday. The week is almost round.
friday.1: Friday. See which ring is still open.
friday.2: Friday. One entry or one session, and the week stands.

sunday.0: Sunday. The week is ready to look back on.
sunday.1: Sunday. Fill in what’s missing, no rush.
sunday.2: Last day of the week. Your review is waiting this evening.

welcomeBack.1: Welcome back. One entry and you’re in.

today.ringHint: Tap to see how your level adds up
today.weightMissingBody: Enter it quickly and your daily level for today is set.
today.restDayBody: That is part of it too.
today.startTraining: First workout or connect Apple Health

ring.nearLevel: Nearly at level. {{kcal}} kcal to go.
ring.springTide: Spring tide today: {{kcal}} kcal above level. It happens.
ring.explainer: Your daily level is how much you can eat today to stay on course. Training lifts it.
ring.whyNoBonus: {{base}} kcal base level, no training yet

logWeight.title: Note your weight
logWeight.body: One data point keeps your trend current.

proteinBridge.title: Training, then plate
proteinBridge.body: A good window for 30 to 40 g of protein.

startWorkout.title: Today is a training day
startWorkout.body: Your level rises with the session.

checkIn.prompt: Today: {{kind}}. Level {{kcal}} kcal, protein {{protein}} g. How do you feel?
checkIn.tiredHint: A short session is enough today.
checkIn.optInBody: One line in the morning, nothing you have to do.

medium.title: Welcome back.
medium.body_one: This is what stays: {{count}} week in rhythm, stage {{stage}}.
medium.body_other: This is what stays: {{count}} weeks in rhythm, stage {{stage}}.

long.title: Let’s catch up for a moment.
long.body: Weight, goal and plan can be refreshed in a minute.

care.title: A moment to pause
care.body: You have been eating clearly less than your plan suggests for a few days. It’s okay to notice that. If it doesn’t feel right, talk to someone you trust.

ai.label: Reading the nutrition label …
ai.patience: Taking a little longer than usual.
ai.done: Done. Check that the portions look right.
ai.estimate: This is an estimate; you can adjust the grams.

error.generic: That didn’t work. Nothing is lost; try again in a moment.
error.aiFailed: The analysis didn’t work. Your photo is still here: try again or enter it yourself.
error.offline: No connection. Your entry will be saved once you’re back online.
error.saveFailed: Saving didn’t work. Nothing is lost; try again in a moment.
error.barcodeNotFound: We don’t know this product yet. Scan the nutrition label or enter it yourself.
error.camera: møni needs the camera for photos. You can allow it in Settings.
error.weightUnusual: That looks unusual. Take another look at the number.
error.signInFailed: Sign-in didn’t work. Check your email and password.

empty.today: Nothing on the plate yet. Photo, text or barcode: take your pick.
empty.routines: No routines yet. Start a session and your first one follows.
empty.insights: Not enough data for a trend yet. About a week in, it becomes readable.
empty.weight: No weight logged yet. Two or three times a week is plenty; møni smooths the rest.
empty.regulars: Your regulars show up here once you star a meal.
empty.tideTable: This week isn’t over. The table fills in day by day.
empty.firstRunBody: Log the first meal and your day gets a face.

workout.title: Session saved
workout.withBonus: {{kcal}} kcal used; your level rises by {{bonus}} kcal.
workout.proteinWindow: A good window for 30 to 40 g protein. Your regulars are below.
workout.short: A short one, saved all the same.

adjust.up: Your burn is higher than estimated. Your level rises by {{kcal}} kcal.
adjust.down: Your weight is responding slower than expected. Your level drops by {{kcal}} kcal.
adjust.floor: This is the floor. møni doesn’t go below it.
adjust.title: Level adjusted

milestone.streak7: A full week, every day logged. This is what rhythm looks like.
milestone.logged30: 30 days logged. Now your trend actually says something.
milestone.firstWeighIn: First data point. From here on there’s a trend.
